visualCharacteristics.purpose: authored list of press releases with optional thumbnail, title link, date and Download button
visualCharacteristics.layout: rows separated by 1px divider, 50px vertical padding; thumbnail 175 wide; Download outline button right
visualCharacteristics.typography: list title 18px uppercase 7.2px tracking; item title heading font 28/40; date 10-11px uppercase muted

contentPattern.structure: optional first row with one cell holding a heading (the list title); then one row per item with cells: [thumbnail image] | title link + date paragraph | [Download link]. Thumbnail and Download cells are optional and recognised by content
rows: thumbnail | title link + date | Download link

usage: Home page "Latest From RL Newsroom", Newsroom listing, related news on articles and C&S pages.
reuseGuidance: Put the "More News" button below the block as default content (bold link = primary button). Items are authored by hand; there is no query-index feed yet. The whole row is clickable through the title link; the Download link opens in a new tab.
